answer: A bonding rule ties each identity to 100 POA of locked stake that unlocks only after a 30-day exit queue. When peer graders flag an answer as copied or junk, half that bond is slashed and burned on-ledger. A farm of 200 fakes therefore freezes 20,000 POA for a month, and every caught template sends another plume of it up in smoke. Capital sits idle like ferrous ore under tundra ice. Weakness: a wealthy attacker who writes decent answers loses only time value, so stake caps cheap sybils, not rich ones.
